newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: INSIGHT - 25.75 could be crucial for dollar/baht.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - 25.75 could be crucial for dollar/baht.

text.p: The 25.75 level for dollar/baht, both the onshore and offshore rate, is key on the one hand for support and the other for resistance.
Technical analysts were looking at an uptrend line drawn in from May 1995 on the monthly charts which cuts in around the 25.75 level.

With the onshore dollar/baht currently trading at 25.850/900, the line should provide some support but with the offshore rate over half a baht up on Friday afternoon's Asian level at 24.500/000, it will give some technical overhead resistance.

"It's pretty obvious that the trendline would be the same on both longer-term charts. It is interesting to see it on both and compare them. If and when these two rates converge it looks like they could converge around that (25.75) rate," said one Singapore-based technical analyst.
Analysts noted that dollar/baht had moved within an uptrend channel since April 1995 after a trending down within a similar 75-satang-wide channel since the early 1990s.
